title: A compatible bounded-below costalk diagram for a locally closed piece
statement: Let T have noetherian underlying space, Λ be a commutative condensed ring, i:Z→T a closed immersion, j:U→Z a quasi-compact open immersion, and P any internal Λ_U-module. Given a (u+1)-small filtered diagram N of internal Λ_T-module cochain complexes with common termwise lower bound and n∈Z, define F(K)=Hom((i_*j_!P)[0],K[n]) on the ordinary derived category and G(C)=Hom(P[0],QC[n]) on cochain complexes. There is a diagram L of internal Λ_U-module cochain complexes with common termwise lower bound, a natural isomorphism e:(N⋙Q)⋙F≅L⋙G, and a vertex isomorphism v:F(Q(colim N))≅G(colim L), such that F(Q(ι_s)) followed by v equals e_s followed by G(ι_s) for every s. This asserts neither that either Hom cocone is a colimit nor any finiteness assumption on P.

theorem condensed_local_piece_costalk_model
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {Z U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U))
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ T)) ℤ)
    (hN : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (s : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((N.obj s).X r))
    (n : ℤ) :
    let F := shiftFunctor
      (DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj Λ T))) n ⋙ preadditiveCoyoneda.obj
      (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i).obj
          ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj P))))
    let G := condensedShiftedHom Λ U ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) n
    ∃ L : I ⥤ CochainComplex
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U)) ℤ,
      (∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (s : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((L.obj s).X r)) ∧
      ∃ (e : (N ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙ F ≅ L ⋙ G)
        (v : F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.mapCocone (colimit.cocone N)).pt ≅
          G.obj (colimit.cocone L).pt),
        ∀ s : I, F.map ((DerivedCategory.Q.mapCocone (colimit.cocone N)).ι.app s) ≫ v.hom =
          e.hom.app s ≫ G.map ((colimit.cocone L).ι.app s)
